limitations: Historical pilots run before the declaration; not preregistered final trials and not held out.
Pre- and post-tuned differ in the planner prompt (A_PROMPT_TUNING.md) and also in controller code; not a prompt-only controlled comparison.
Pilot-28 and Pilot-29 ran different prompt versions, so they are not repeats of one frozen policy.
